title: ChatGPT Launches Apple Messages Plugin for Automated Text Management
summary: OpenAI has introduced an Apple Messages plugin for ChatGPT, enabling users to manage their text messages through the AI chatbot. The plugin allows sorting, analyzing, editing, drafting, sending, and deleting messages. It supports both personal and professional use via Codex and ChatGPT Work. Privacy concerns are noted, as the plugin runs locally but specifics remain unclear. OpenAI advises users to monitor ChatGPT's actions and avoid enabling persistent approval to maintain control over sent messages.
key_points: OpenAI released an Apple Messages plugin for ChatGPT, integrating AI with iMessage.
Users can sort, analyze, edit, draft, send, and delete messages via ChatGPT.
The plugin works with Codex and ChatGPT Work for professional use cases.
OpenAI claims the plugin runs locally on the user's device, but privacy details are vague.
Persistent approval for message sending is discouraged to retain user oversight.
Potential privacy risks exist despite local processing assurances.
